neet_phy_u06_t01_1.working: In free fall without air resistance, every body has acceleration g whatever its mass, so the ratio is 1:1.

neet_phy_u06_t01_2.working: g' = g R^2/(R+h)^2 = g/4 gives R+h = 2R, so h = R.

neet_phy_u06_t01_3.working: At height: g(1-2h/R). At depth: g(1-d/R). Equating gives d = 2h = 32 km.

neet_phy_u06_t01_4.working: A: g/(2)^2 = g/4 (IV). B: g(1-1/2) = g/2 (II). C: g = 0 at the centre (I). D: g is proportional to rho*R, so doubling R gives 2g (III).

neet_phy_u06_t01_5.working: A true: g = GM/R^2 = (4/3)pi G rho R. B true: g = g(r/R) inside. C false: g is zero at the centre. D true: height loss 2h/R versus depth loss h/R. E false: mass is invariant.
